summary: Frontend regression/sanity test for multi-display BLE picker plumbing (ble.ts, matrix.tsx, device.tsx, index.tsx). Confirmed no crashes/regressions introduced. Real multi-device picker behavior not testable in web preview (no BLE hardware) per problem statement - correctly skipped.
critical_code_review_comments: matrix.tsx connect() flow reviewed: tries last-known device (AsyncStorage LAST_DEVICE_KEY) first, falls back to scanForDevices(), auto-connects on single match, returns {name:'', picker:true} + populates pickerDevices on multiple matches. Logic is sound and bleStatus correctly resets to 'disconnected' when handing off to picker (avoids stuck 'Connecting...' UI).

device.tsx Modal picker sheet correctly wrapped in Fragment alongside KeyboardAwareScrollView; visible prop bound to `!!pickerDevices && pickerDevices.length > 0` so it stays hidden by default (verified in browser - no visual/layout impact on rest of Device screen, no console errors).
index.tsx onConnect handler correctly redirects to /device when picker:true is returned from connect().
No obvious bugs found in the reviewed files for this round's scope.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified via Playwright at mobile viewport (375x667): (1) Home/Summary tab status pill tap -> shows 'Bluetooth needs a real device build.' toast correctly, no crash. (2) Device tab status card tap -> same graceful BLE_UNAVAILABLE toast, no crash. (3) Picker Modal confirmed NOT visible by default (pickerDevices null), no layout impact, no console errors related to it. (4) Navigated Sports, Flights, Weather, Summary tabs after Device tab interactions - no red screen errors, no render exceptions in any tab. Console only showed expected dev warnings (shadow* deprecated, useNativeDriver, pointerEvents deprecated) - none related to the new BLE picker code. Real multi-device BLE picker UI (2+ devices, selecting one) could NOT be tested since Expo web preview has no BLE hardware stack, as expected/acknowledged in the request.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no bugs found this round.
